INVESTIGATION OF ANTIPHOSPHOLIPID SYNDROME
Investigations
- FBC and ESR
- Serology
- Anti-B2 glycoprotein antibodies IgG, IgM, IgA
- Anti-cardiolipin antibodies(aCL) IgG, IgM, IgA
- Lupus anticoagulant(LAC)
- Antinuclear antibody(ANA)
- Other Antibodies to phospholipids( many are not yet in clinical use) eg
phosphatidylserine, phosphatidic acid, phosphatidylinositol
- ECHO, Doppler US scan , CT angiogram and Brain CT scan
